title: Red Pesto Spaghetti
subtitle: Cook Once, Serve More!
description: Serve up more with our Feed A Crowd recipes! Using more hearty ingredients like filling carbs, proteins and veggies, you can satisfy extra hungry tummies or keep something for tomorrow’s lunch. If you’re on a 2-person plan, these recipes make 4 portions; on a 4-person plan, they make 8 portions.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a large saucepan of salted water to the boil for the pasta. Finely chop the onions. Cut the capsicums into 2cm chunks. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Finely grate the parmesan.

Cook pasta: Cook three-quarters of the pasta in the pan of boiling water for 12 mins or until al dente. Reserve 250ml (1 cup) cooking water, then drain the pasta. Return to the pan and cover to keep warm.

Saute veggies: Meanwhile, heat 1 tbs olive oil in a large deep frypan over medium heat. Cook the onion, capsicum and garlic, stirring occasionally, for 5-6 mins until the onion is softened. Add the red pesto and cook, stirring, for 1 min or until fragrant.

Simmer sauce: Add the tomatoes, reserved cooking water and 2 tsp sugar to the veggies and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, for 8-9 mins until slightly thickened. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Remove the pan from the heat.
Serve up: Add the sauce to the pasta (see Feed A Crowd) and toss to combine. Divide among plates, scatter over the parmesan and enjoy!
Feed A Crowd: Is your pasta sticking? Drizzle with a little olive oil and toss to loosen before serving.
